name: Bog Busters
detailed_description:
Survival Beyond Racing
Step into Bog Busters, where it's not just about speed and racing—it's about mastering your vehicle, adapting to a dynamic environment, and making strategic decisions to survive. Face extreme landscapes, battle unpredictable natural forces, and find ways to endure the wilderness.

Your Vehicle — Your Lifeline
In Bog Busters, your off-road vehicle is more than just transportation—it’s your key to overcoming harsh terrain. Learn to navigate challenging routes, adapt to changing road conditions, and push your skills to the limit. A vehicle customization system, including upgrades to suspension, tires, and engines, is planned for future updates.

A Living, Unpredictable World
From dense forests to rocky mountains, every region presents unique challenges. Weather conditions change dynamically—clear skies can turn into a downpour, and dry roads can become treacherous swamps. Explore and stay prepared for the unexpected.

Survival in the Wild (Feature in Development)
Future updates for Bog Busters will introduce survival mechanics, including hunting animals, gathering resources, and crafting tools to stay alive. A planned system will allow players to interact with the environment and use found resources for survival.

Switch Perspectives
Play the way you prefer—seamlessly switch between first-person and third-person views to gain different perspectives and strategic advantages.

Every Action Has Consequences
The world of Bog Busters reacts to your decisions. Future updates will expand this system, where excessive hunting may lead to a scarcity of wildlife, and resource overuse can result in depletion. Survival is not just about facing the elements—it’s about coexisting with the world around you.

Will You Conquer the Wilderness or Be Consumed by It?
The choice is yours.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or AMD equivalent 4 GHz+
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Recommended:

  • Processor: Quad Core Intel i5 or AMD equivalent 4 GHz+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
